question: How many gold medals has the Indian Hockey team won in the Olympics till 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**8**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Hockey Team** has been one of the most successful teams in the history of the **Olympic Games**.
 
• India has won a total of **8 Gold Medals** in hockey at the Olympics till 2023.
 
• The first gold medal was won in the **1928 Amsterdam Olympics**, marking the beginning of India's dominance in the sport.
 
• The successive gold medals were won in the years **1932 (Los Angeles), 1936 (Berlin), 1948 (London), 1952 (Helsinki), 1956 (Melbourne), 1964 (Tokyo),** and **1980 (Moscow)**.
 
• The victory in 1980 at the **Moscow Olympics** was the last time India clinched a gold medal in hockey at the Olympics.
 
• The Indian Hockey Team is known for its remarkable performances during the early and mid-20th century when it was considered invincible in the sport.
 
• India's success in hockey has contributed significantly to the country's history and pride in international sports.
 
• The **Indian Men's Hockey Team** is also the team with the most Olympic gold medals in hockey.
